properties.text:
Welcome to [color=#00e8c3][u]SELENE[/u][/color]
Survive Every Lunar Enemy, Never Evacuate.

[color=#00e8c3][u]Mission information[/u][/color]

Keep all cores alive through every alien wave.

Your operation has 2 phases:
1. Gather: Mine resources and build defenses before the next wave.
2. Wave: Defend cores until the wave ends.

[color=#00e8c3][u]Resources[/u][/color]

During Gather, use the mouse to mine inward from the moon's surface. Mineable ores:



There are also energy ores that require special machinery to mine:

[color=#00e8c3][u]Core[/u][/color]
You start with several core buildings. Each lost core reduces your energy in the next Gather phase. Lose them all, and it's game over.

[color=#00e8c3][u]Turret[/u][/color]
Consume energy and ammo to automatically target and fire at enemies in range. Energy controls fire rate and ammo controls power.

Mining drains the drill's energy, which refills at the start of Gather phase. Check your current energy in the drill bar.


[color=#00e8c3][u]Terminals[/u][/color]

Structures have terminals: red for input and blue for output. Both terminals below handle ammo: left consumes, while the right provides.


Always connect input terminals to a matching output terminal. Energy terminals expect a source of energy, while ammo terminals expect a source of ammo.

[color=#00e8c3][u]Ammo and Energy sources (worst to best)[/u][/color]

- Energy: coal, solar, uranium, and plutonium;
- Ammo: copper, iron, tungsten, uranium, and plutonium.

[color=#00e8c3][u]Silo[/u][/color]
Consume energy to supply copper, iron, or tungsten ammo to turrets. Click a silo to choose its output resource.

[color=#00e8c3][u]Solar panel[/u][/color]
Provide unlimited energy while exposed to sunlight. They are more efficient than coal, but weaker than uranium or plutonium.

[color=#00e8c3][u]Extractor[/u][/color]
Place on coal or uranium to extract energy for other structures. The underlying ore is steadily consumed during the Wave phase.

[color=#00e8c3][u]Transmuter[/u][/color]
When powered by energy and supplied with plutonium through the right terminal, it converts uranium into plutonium.

[color=#00e8c3][u]Connecting structures[/u][/color]

Click a blue output terminal to draw a pipe. Click again to build it. Connect pipes to red input terminals to supply structures. If a pipe ends elsewhere, an intermediate terminal is created.

Pipes cannot cross other structures, so plan ahead. If they get in the way or are no longer useful, you can remove them with the sell function.

The image below shows how buildings interact through pipes.

[color=#00e8c3][u]Surviving the waves[/u][/color]

When you are prepared, press:

As soon as a wave starts, turrets activate as long as they have both energy and ammo. They are your main defense, but you can also click outside the moon to fire from your core globes. These shots are weak and slow, but can save you in a pinch.

During waves, you cannot mine or build, but you can still sell, repair, and connect structures. Click any structure to check its health and status. Watch your solar panels too: the sun rotates during waves, and panels may shut down if they lose sunlight.

Manage your resources carefully. Switch ammo types when needed, delay repairs until necessary, and avoid unnecessary spending.

Good luck, commander.
